lines.cap: Death decided to learn to drive. His instructor will never be the same.
lines.say: Death decided to learn to drive. His instructor will never be the same.

lines.cap: Okay. Mirror, signal, and relax. You seem tense.
lines.say: Okay. Mirror, signal, and relax. You seem tense.

lines.cap: I am four thousand years old. I have never relaxed.
lines.say: I am four thousand years old. I have never relaxed.

lines.cap: They pull onto the road. Every other car suddenly changes lane. Far away.
lines.say: They pull onto the road. Every other car suddenly changes lane. Far away.

lines.cap: Why is. Why is everyone avoiding us?
lines.say: Why is. Why is everyone avoiding us?

lines.cap: Even the traffic is scared of him. Smart traffic.
lines.say: Even the traffic is scared of him. Smart traffic.

lines.cap: Death passes. Perfect score. The examiner is shaking.
lines.say: Death passes. Perfect score. The examiner is shaking.

lines.cap: You're the safest driver I've ever seen. Nobody came within a mile.
lines.say: You're the safest driver I've ever seen. Nobody came within a mile.

lines.cap: Tag the worst driver you know. Death just passed his test.
lines.say: Tag the worst driver you know. Death just passed his test.
